notes.title: 1.4.0 Patch Notes - New Mode: Time Attack!
notes.notes:
Introducing a New Mode: Time Attack!

Strive for the highest score within a constrained timeframe!

Initially, you are given 30 seconds, but for every apple the Snake consumes, an additional second is added to the clock! 

Let's discover who can become the ultimate Time Attack champion!
